messages:
Asha (eng-sre): Heads up — saw a ~22% bump in our US‑WEST H100 egress/network line on the latest invoice. Looks like a VPC NAT / egress pricing change from the cloud provider. cc @Marco (finance) @Priya
Marco (finance): Oof. Can you paste the invoice line or export? Need to know whether this is one-off or persistent.
Priya (eng-infra): Which zones/regions are affected? If it's just cross‑AZ NAT traffic we might be able to rework peering/private IP paths.
Sam (platform): Did we flip any load balancer or NAT gateway config last week? I rolled the outbound NAT rules on 3/12 but only for eu-west.
Asha (eng-sre): Attached snippet from billing export (redacted):
```
invoice_line: COMPUTE_NET_EGRESS | region: us-west1 | resource: h100-nodepool | amount: $48,234.67 | prev_month: $39,620.15
```
Notably line item shows new per-GB egress rate.
Billing Bot: Detected anomaly: +21.7% change in "COMPUTE_NET_EGRESS" for project: redwood-prod-us-west compared to prior 30d window. Alert ID: bb-4421
Marco (finance): Quick back‑of‑envelope — if unit cost increased 22% and our token economics run on $0.0008/token for that fleet, new unit would be ~$0.00098/token. That eats ~12% of gross margin on hosted tiers.
Priya (eng-infra): If this persists, reserved GPU commits could insulate compute cost but not network egress. We should check whether committed usage discounts include network egress — usually not.
Ops Oncall: Oncall logs show spike in cross‑zone traffic 3/14 02:00-06:00 UTC. Top talkers: cache-miss service + batch replays from analytics.
Sam (platform): Two immediate mitigations: 1) add egress routing to keep model traffic inside VPC (private IPs / VPC peering) where possible; 2) throttle large analytic replays or shift them to off-peak / different region. Both need config changes + small infra window.
Asha (eng-sre): Agreed. Also want to evaluate whether Dedicated commitments should be grown in us‑west to avoid potential price shocks on hosted traffic. Marco — can you model pass‑through vs absorb for incremental cost?
Marco (finance): I'll run three scenarios: (A) absorb cost for next quarter, (B) pass full egress delta to customers (impact on price competitiveness), (C) partial pass with packaging changes (new egress surcharge on heavy ML pipelines). ETA 24h.
Priya (eng-infra): Can we get the exact per-GB delta from billing export? I can try a quick script: `SELECT region, resource, SUM(bytes) as bytes, SUM(cost) as cost FROM billing_export WHERE resource LIKE '%h100%' GROUP BY region`
Asha (eng-sre): Running that now on the exported table, will paste results.
Asha (eng-sre): Results (sanitized):
```
us-west1 | bytes: 4.3TB | cost: $48,234.67 | prev_cost: $39,620.15
eu-west1 | bytes: 1.1TB | cost: $12,010.11 | prev_cost: $11,900.00
```
Sam (platform): Looks concentrated in us‑west. We should prioritize keeping intra‑region traffic private there.
Marco (finance): Initial scenario numbers: (A) absorb = ~$8.6k/month hit to gross margin; (B) pass-through = could raise unit price by ~2.5% for affected customers; (C) partial pass = ~1.2% price increase + new premium plan for heavy-training customers.
Priya (eng-infra): Engineering cost to move traffic to private IPs estimated 1 engineer * 2 days + small LB changes. Ops risk low.
Ops Oncall: Note: switching routing mid‑day caused a brief upload queue backlog in staging last time. Schedule maintenance window.
Asha (eng-sre): Action items: 1) Priya to scope and schedule private‑IP routing change for us‑west (ETA 48h). 2) Marco to finalize pricing/packaging scenarios (24h). 3) Sam to add guardrails to throttle analytics replays (ASAP). 4) Asha to open a billing escalation with provider to confirm price change is intended vs meter bug.
Marco (finance): Will also run sensitivity on reserved capacity buys — if we increase Dedicated EM commitments, does provider offer network egress credits bundling? Historically no, but I'll double check.
Priya (eng-infra): FYI if provider confirms a permanent egress rate bump we should fold that into our Optimize recommendations and into our model/quantization suggestions to reduce tokens.
Asha (eng-sre): Thanks — tagging #product and #support after Marco finishes the pricing note.
Sam (platform): Quick FYI: temporary mitigation script posted to ops-runbooks (link). Use `ops route-check --dry-run --region us-west1` before applying.
Marco (finance): Updating the cost model now. Will post a short deck with 3 scenarios and recommended next steps.
Asha (eng-sre): Closing loop — will follow up once billing team responds. :eyes:
